description: This Java class 'TransactionDaoImpl' implements data access layer functionality for 'Transaction' entities, specifically providing a method to list transactions by associated order using QueryDSL.

classes.name: TransactionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of TransactionDao for transaction data access, utilizing QueryDSL and extending generic DAO functionality.

methods.name: listByOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Transaction entities associated with a specific Order by querying with join on order ID.
